body.purpose: Base size for nearly everything: task titles, row content, form fields.

label.purpose: Row metadata: timestamps, counts, project/priority chips.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase tracked group-header pattern: Projects/Resources headers, list-date groupings, settings section titles.

micro.purpose: Tightest tier: mobile bottom-nav captions, emoji-picker category dividers.

shadows.name: control-rest
shadows.purpose: Barely-there separation on buttons and inputs at rest.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: True floating overlays: dialogs, sheets, popovers.

motion.name: ease-swipe
motion.purpose: Snap-back easing for the mobile swipe-to-complete/delete gesture.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default button variant; solid accent fill, used for the one primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button; transparent fill with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.274 0.006 286.618); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used across quick-add, task edit, and settings forms.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.274 0.006 286.618); background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Priority Badge
components.description: Pill badge used for status/priority labels; not interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: oklch(0.65 0.21 25); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: The core signature component: a scannable row with status icon, title, and right-aligned metadata (recurrence, dates, priority, project). Selected state raises to Panel Raised with an accent ring; hover raises to Panel.
components.html: Write the quarterly reviewP2 · Mar 4
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 14px; } .ds-row:hover { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); } .ds-row-check { color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-title { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-meta { font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar navigation item; flat at rest, raises to Panel Raised when active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); } .ds-nav-active { background: oklch(0.274 0.006 286.618); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); }

narrative.overview: finish-em is a dense, dark-first instrument panel for one operator, not a storefront for many visitors. Every surface — the task list, the status bar's overdue/today/week counters, the weekly goals ticker, the calendar sync — is built to stay visible and legible at once, the way a console keeps its gauges in view rather than hiding them behind menus. The palette is almost entirely achromatic zinc; the only saturated color is the four-step priority scale, which exists to be read at a glance across a long list, not to decorate it. Density and speed lead; decoration follows only where it clarifies status. This is explicitly not a soft, illustrated, Todoist-style task app — it takes its cues from Linear: keyboard-first, dark-mode-native, information-dense without becoming cluttered.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated signal system (priority p1-p4), reserved for meaning
Flat surfaces distinguished by tone, not shadow
Small radii, tight padding, 14px base type — built for scanning rows, not reading prose
Touch and keyboard both first-class (swipe gestures on mobile, hotkeys on desktop), never at odds

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Priority colors (p1-p4) exist to be read as status at a glance across a list — due-date urgency, priority flags, completion state. They are never used decoratively. Future chart or data-viz work may extend this palette, but any new color must carry the same signal role, not a brand or mood role.

rules.name: The Four Sizes, Not One Rule
rules.body: The type scale has exactly four steps -- 14px (Title/Body), 12px (Label), 11px (Section Label), 10px (Micro) -- each tied to a specific role, not a free-floating small/smaller scale. Reach for weight, tracking, case, and color (muted vs foreground) to add emphasis within a step before ever introducing a fifth size.

dos: Do keep the priority palette (p1-p4) as the only saturated color family; every new status or signal should map onto it or extend it with the same signal-only role, not introduce a new hue.
Do use tone-stepping (background -> surface -> surface-raised) for depth and state, not shadow.
Do keep the body type at 14px and reach for weight/color before introducing a new type size.
Do give every touch-only row a 44px minimum tap target without changing its desktop density.
donts: Don't wrap ordinary list content in a card. Rows sit directly on the page background; borders and tone shifts do the separating work cards would otherwise do.
Don't add colored or thick borders (side-stripes, accent outlines) as a decorative device. Borders are always the 1px hairline token.
Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, or ambient shadow — the system is flat and tonal by design.
Don't let the Nyan Cat / easter-egg register bleed into primary task, project, or planning surfaces — personality stays in the status bar corner it already owns.
